metadata.title: Bayesian Diagnostic Insights: A Software Tool for Applying Bayes' Theorem in Medical Diagnostics
metadata.description: This software tool is a specialized program developed in Wolfram Language for the parametric estimation, visualization, and comparison of Bayesian diagnostic measures and their uncertainty. The program utilizes Bayes' theorem to compute the posterior probabilities for disease and absence of the disease, as well as the diagnostic threshold-derived positive and negative predictive values. It uses advanced uncertainty propagation methods to quantify their standard sampling, measurement, and combined uncertainty using normal, lognormal, and gamma distributions. The tool enhances the estimation process and facilitates the comparison of these Bayesian diagnostic measures, which are critical for medical practice. Furthermore, it provides a robust framework for analyzing uncertainty, thereby aiding in the understanding and applying of probabilistic methods in medical diagnostics.
metadata.notes: Bayesian Diagnostic Insights can be run on Wolfram Player® or Wolfram Mathematica®

metadata.title: 中医经济学(Traditional Chinese Medicine Economics)
metadata.description:
内容概要:

本书是中医经济学作为一门独立学科的奠基之作。承继前人开拓,本书完成了从“方法论类比”到“本体论革命”、从“政策应用”到“学科体系”、从“哲学思辨”到“科学实证”的三重跃迁,标志着经济学范式的一次深刻变革。

全书二十一章仿照中医“医道”精心构筑,形成“道—体—用—证—诊—治—境”的完整认知闭环:从哲学根基与人性论革命出发,经经济生命体论、气血经络五行等本体构造与运行机理,通过病理分析与诊断辨证,最终归于治疗方略与文明境界。

本书以“经济生命体论”颠覆西方经济学的机械本体论,将经济系统确认为具有自组织、自适应、自我调节能力的生命有机体;以“气血经络五行”重构要素、产业与区域理论,为经济学提供非还原论的整体分析范式。在治理层面,“四诊合参”“八纲辨证”“八法调控”“政策复方”等工具可直接转化为宏观经济决策的操作手册,实现从“逆周期调节”到“辨证管理”、从“挑选赛道”到“调理生态”的方法论跃迁。在危机应对上,“内外合邪”病因学与“扶正祛邪”原则,为防范化解系统性风险提供了超越单一归因的系统方案。本书最终指向中国自主经济学知识体系的构建,为全球治理贡献“阴阳平衡”的东方智慧,使经济学从“修理机器”的技术官僚之学,升华为“调理生命”的治理艺术。

metadata.title: Огляд сучасного стану систем виявлення та інформування про наявність застарілого програмного забезпечення
metadata.description:
This paper reviews publications that examine the current state of systems for detecting depression and abandonment in the npm, Maven, and Python ecosystems. It was determined how researchers analyse the causes of project abandonment in
different ecosystems, the prevalence of this phenomenon, and the reaction of developers and users to the removal of inactive dependencies. Proposed solutions that prevent the likely decline of a project were taken into account, and the effectiveness of such solutions was investigated. The analysis of the studies helped to identify the needs and challenges in creating a mechanism for predicting the continuous operation time of software.
В цьому матеріалі був проведений огляд публікацій, які досліджують сучасний стан систем виявлення депрекації та занедбання у екосистемах npm, Maven та Python. Визначено, як дослідники аналізують причини занедбання проєктів у різних екосистемах, розповсюдженість такого явища, та реакцію розробників та користувачів щодо вилучення неактивних залежностей. Були взяті до уваги запропоновані рішення, які попереджують ймовірний занепад проєкту, а також досліджено показники ефективності таких рішень. Аналіз досліджень допоміг визначити потреби та виклики при cтворенні механізму прогнозування часу безперервної роботи ПЗ.

metadata.title: zhangdx2025/tree-mortality-soil-carbon: v1.0.0 — Analysis code for Topographic Decoupling of Tree-Mortality Disturbances Drives Contrasting Soil Carbon Fates via Divergent Microbial Strategies
metadata.description:
Overview

This release archives the R code used to process data, perform statistical analyses, train machine-learning models, generate figures, and save numerical outputs for the revised manuscript:

Topographic Decoupling of Tree-Mortality Disturbances Drives Contrasting Soil Carbon Fates via Divergent Microbial Strategies

Contents

This release includes:

  • Eleven numbered analysis scripts covering data processing, statistical analyses, genome-informed microbial trait analyses, XGBoost model training, SHAP analyses, metagenomic gene-abundance analyses, figure generation, and numerical output generation.
  • Scripts associated with Figs. 1–5, Supplementary Figs. 1–8, and Supplementary Tables 1–5.
  • A subset of small supporting data files required by the scripts.
  • Documentation of the analysis workflow, software environment, approximate runtimes, and required folder structure.

Associated data

The complete processed dataset and saved analysis outputs are available in Zenodo (V2):

https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20849331

Raw sequence data are available in the China National GeneBank Sequence Archive under the following project accessions:

  • Amplicon sequencing data: CNP0008410
  • Shotgun metagenomic sequencing data: CNP0008455

Reproducibility

The analyses were conducted in R v4.5.1. The required R packages are loaded within the individual scripts.

For a complete rerun, users should download the processed data and saved analysis outputs from Zenodo, arrange them according to the folder structure described in the README, and run scripts 01–11 in numerical order. Saved analysis outputs may also be used to reproduce figures and tables without rerunning the most computationally intensive steps.

metadata.title: Collaborative Tools and Communication Platforms for Remote Learning
metadata.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has dramatically transformed the educational landscape, rapidly accelerating the global shift toward remote learning and emphasizing the urgent need for robust and effective collaborative tools and communication platforms. As schools and universities adapted to the unprecedented circumstances of widespread lockdowns and physical distancing, these technologies became essential for maintaining instructional continuity and fostering student engagement in virtual environments. This review delves into the existing body of literature on the subject, critically analysing the effectiveness of various collaborative tools and communication platforms in supporting remote learning. It also explores the challenges that educators and institutions have faced in implementing these technologies, such as issues related to technical difficulties, equity, access, and the digital divide. Furthermore, the review outlines best practices for integrating these tools into educational frameworks, stressing the importance of adequate teacher training, inclusive access, and supportive learning environments to ensure the successful adoption and sustained use of these technologies. By offering a comprehensive understanding of these key areas, this study aims to provide valuable insights for educational institutions seeking to enhance their remote learning programmes and optimise student outcomes in a post-pandemic world.
